vecadd.test:
# size 1023 (single block, tail handling)
assert torch.allclose(
    add(torch.ones(1023), torch.ones(1023)),
    torch.full(1023, 2.0),
    "tail 1023"
# size 1025 (two blocks, one element in second block)
assert torch.allclose(
    add(torch.ones(1025), torch.ones(1025)),
    torch.cat([torch.full(1024, 2.0), torch.full(1, 2.0)]),
    "tail 1025"
# size 2048 (exact multiple of block size)
assert torch.allclose(
    add(torch.ones(2048), torch.ones(2048)),
    torch.full(2048, 2.0),
    "power‑of‑2 2048"
# large near‑limit size
assert torch.allclose(
    add(torch.ones(98303), torch.ones(98303)),
    torch.full(98303, 2.0),
    "large tail 98303"
# half‑precision edge case
torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float16)
assert torch.allclose(
    add(torch.ones(100, dtype=torch.float16), torch.ones(100, dtype=torch.float16)),
    torch.full(100, 2.0, dtype=torch.float16),
    "fp16 small"
torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float32)
# precision test with known float values
assert torch.allclose(
    add(torch.tensor([0.1], dtype=torch.float32), torch.tensor([0.2], dtype=torch.float32)),
    torch.tensor([0.3], dtype=torch.float32),
    "float32 precision"
)

softmax.test:
# Additional stress tests exposing boundary, tail, extreme‑scale, and precision edge cases
x = torch.randn(1, 1)
assert torch.allclose(softmax(x), torch.softmax(x, dim=1), atol=1e-5), "1x1 failed"

x = torch.randn(1, 2)
assert torch.allclose(softmax(x), torch.softmax(x, dim=1), atol=1e-5), "1x2 failed"

x = torch.randn(3, 8)
assert torch.allclose(softmax(x), torch.softmax(x, dim=1), atol=1e-5), "3x8 failed"

x = torch.randn(2, 123)
assert torch.allclose(softmax(x), torch.softmax(x, dim=1), atol=1e-5), "2x123 failed"

x = torch.randn(2, 10) * 1000.0
assert torch.allclose(softmax(x), torch.softmax(x, dim=1), atol=1e-3), "large positive scale failed"

x = torch.randn(2, 10) * -1000.0
assert torch.allclose(softmax(x), torch.softmax(x, dim=1), atol=1e-3), "large negative scale failed"

x = torch.randn(2, 10) * 1e-6
assert torch.allclose(softmax(x), torch.softmax(x, dim=1), atol=1e-5), "tiny scale failed"

x = torch.randn(1000, 4)
assert torch.allclose(softmax(x), torch.softmax(x, dim=1), atol=1e-5), "1000x4 failed"

matmul.test:
# Additional edge‑case and numerical tests
# 1. Minimal size
check(1, 1, 1)
# 2. Dimensions not divisible by block size (64)
check(63, 64, 31)
check(64, 63, 31)
check(63, 63, 31)
# 3. Asymmetric shapes
check(128, 256, 129)
check(256, 128, 129)
# 4. Larger but still small
check(128, 128, 128)
# 5. Very small K to stress tail loop
check(32, 32, 1)
check(32, 32, 2)
# 6. High‑magnitude values to test overflow/precision
torch.manual_seed(0)
a = torch.randn((32, 32), dtype=torch.float16) * 1e4
b = torch.randn((32, 32), dtype=torch.float16) * 1e4
assert torch.allclose(matmul(a, b), torch.matmul(a, b), atol=0.5, rtol=0), "large_magnitude"
